findings.title: No certificates found
findings.explanation: The input was read, but it contains no certificate that could be inspected.

remediation.text: Check that the right file was given and that it contains a certificate.

findings.title: Malformed PEM block
findings.explanation: A PEM block could not be decoded: its BEGIN line is invalid, its matching END line is missing, or its contents are not valid base64. The other blocks in the same input are still inspected.

remediation.text: Export the certificate again from its source instead of repairing the file by hand.
